cases.scope: VM misc/alloc spinlock prefix, ticket and POSIX boolean/void mutex interfaces, threaded on/off. Legacy controls characterize unchecked mutex-backed macro returns, not the selected ticket backend's native failure. Blind destroy is an injected bad repair. Fixed is an unimplemented prefix transaction. Ticket initialization is modeled as infallible scalar initialization and destruction as resource-free. Void initialization is assumed normally returning. Excludes subsequent VM-memory failure, lock contention/users, P0 scan spinlock, platform ABI, C weak memory and native admission.
